A1.justification: Both PDFs describe SeCap and the LAGPeR/G2APS-ReID dataset contributions. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and complete supplementary material support reliable comparison, including the additional appendix page in v2.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark experiments, component ablations, cross-dataset evaluation, parameter analyses, and retrieval visualizations in the main text and supplement.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and adds a LAGPeR ground-to-ground evaluation in Section 15 and Table 10.

M1.justification: The VDT encoder, Prompt Re-calibration Module, Local Feature Refinement Module, attention operations, and optimization objectives remain unchanged. The added evaluation does not introduce a method adaptation.

E1.justification: Section 15 adds a dedicated ground-to-ground G↔G scenario using a reconstructed LAGPeR subset. Previously, LAGPeR evaluation covered A→G, G→A, and G→A+G. Ground-to-ground evaluation on CARGO already existed, and all five datasets remain covered.

E2.justification: Comparator memberships in the existing experiments remain unchanged. New Table 10 uses a subset of previously evaluated methods—ViT, VDT, and TransReID—without introducing or modifying a comparison method.

E3.justification: Section 15 introduces evaluation on a reconstructed LAGPeR subset with ground images serving as both queries and gallery candidates. Its construction rules, split, and sample counts are unspecified. Existing evaluation settings, metrics, and training budgets are unchanged.

E4.justification: The component ablations, cross-dataset analysis, prompt-length and loss-weight sweeps, retrieval examples, and attention visualizations are retained. The new ground-to-ground benchmark table and scene illustrations do not add an ablation, robustness analysis, or error study.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, standard deviations, or significance tests. Table 10 continues the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: Existing numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged. New Table 10 reports LAGPeR G↔G Rank-1/mAP of 79.57/78.26 for SeCap, versus 79.23/78.09 for TransReID, 78.36/77.38 for ViT, and 77.18/76.35 for VDT. These are additional results, not improvements over earlier same-setting scores.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation in Equations 1–7 is unchanged. Neither version adds formal assumptions, propositions, proofs, or substantive derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction retain the same claims about adaptive prompts, local feature refinement, two dataset contributions, and superior AGPReID performance. The shortened conclusion removes repeated dataset details without changing these contributions or their scope.

C2.justification: Explanations of PRM's dependence on VDT, head-feature matching, cross-dataset behavior, parameter sensitivity, and privacy implications remain unchanged. Section 15 reports an additional performance finding without introducing a substantive mechanism explanation or limitation.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 removes v1's explanation of grouping images by identity and view, clustering their gradient-histogram features into K groups, and randomly selecting one query per group. The brief clustering reference remains, so this is reduced documentation rather than an established preprocessing change. Implementation settings and the code/data link are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds four background references on pose normalization, multiscale attention, and cloth-changing ReID (references 23–25 and 29), while removing two 2022 group-ReID papers cited as references 32–33 in v1. The positioning relative to AG-ReID and VDT remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 expands author affiliations, adds funding acknowledgments, shortens the query-selection discussion and conclusion, and appends Sections 14–15. The main narrative, terminology, and section ordering remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds Figure 9 with paired aerial/ground scene examples and Table 10 with methods arranged as columns for the G↔G comparison. Existing figures and tables are retained, with limited reflow following the front-matter and text edits.

improvement.justification: Figure 9 improves dataset illustration, and Table 10 adds evidence for ground-only retrieval. However, the new subset's construction and split are insufficiently documented, while Section 4.1 removes query-sampling instructions available in v1. With the central method and existing evidence unchanged, these limited gains and reproducibility losses do not establish a reliable net quality improvement or deterioration.
